articles.title: IHC reserves ruling on maintainability of petitions alleging solitary confinement of PTI Founder, Bushra Bibi
articles.summary: The Islamabad High Court reserved its decision on petitions challenging alleged solitary confinement of PTI founder Imran Khan and his wife Bushra Bibi in Adiala Jail.

articles.title: IHC fixes June 29, for hearing PTI founder, Bushra Bibi Appeals in £190 Million case
articles.summary: The Islamabad High Court scheduled a hearing for June 29 on appeals filed by Imran Khan and Bushra Bibi against their convictions in the £190 million case.

articles.title: ATC seeks response from PIMS over delay in submission of medical report in Nov 26 protest case
articles.summary: An Anti-Terrorism Court sought a response from PIMS regarding delays in submitting medical reports in a case related to November 26 protests, in which Imran Khan and other PTI leaders are nominated.
